inconclusive: b9-smoke-timing-karnataka-plain-pcores-20261010 and -high-20261010 set affinity or priority on the
venv launcher stub, not the interpreter; -sampled-20261010 only sampled GPU utilisation.
diagnosis: Windows schedules the windowless interpreter at low quality of service (efficiency cores).
Pinning to logical processors 0-15, the performance cores of this i7-14700K, or turning power
throttling off for the process, restores 0.18 to 0.20 s per chip. B3 run 1 shows the same two
rates in its own journal (0.19 s for the first steps, 0.35 s afterwards).
decision: The launch supervisor pins itself to mask 0xFFFF; the trainer and its DEV scorer inherit it.
This is a process attribute, not a recipe or system setting.
